messages:
liam: Quick run idea — one-hour "mini-bench & playbook" session that bundles a short live benchmark, 100 free starter tokens, and 3 plug-and-play prompt templates (summarize, intent-extract, code-rewrite). Goal: lift first-api-request -> activation within 12h by ~15%.

nina: Love the lean format. Primary metric = activated within 12h. Secondary: prompt-template adoption rate, median latency for starter templates, and 48h re-engagement.

harry: Routing thought: split signups A/B. Variant A = SDR for high-intent (company_size>50 or allowlisted domains). Variant B = instant self-serve with token grant + in-app quickstart. We'll measure activation delta.

bex (growth-eng): I can implement routing flags and landing. Simple routing rules: if company_size>50 => sdr, else => auto_onboard. I’ll also add an opt-in for the A/B test.

bex (growth-eng): Copy snippet for landing: "Mini-bench + hands-on: 100 free tokens + 3 ready prompts — try a quick benchmark in under an hour." Short + product-led.

liam: For the automated flow: immediate email + 100 tokens, in-console prompt pack, and an inline nudge on first API call linking to templates. Also add a 12h follow-up with 3 suggested uses.

nina: Measurement: utm=mini_bench, cohort=mb_may; events = signup, tokens_claimed, prompt_template_invoked, first_api_request, activated, paid_30d. Dashboard: hourly for first 12h, then daily.

harry: For SDR variant, add a 24h outreach reminder if no activation signal. Tag leads with action_required if >1 signup from same org.

liam: Bench snippet to show in slides: "Starter summarize prompt — median latency ~200ms, placeholder unit cost ~$0.015/1k tokens" (we'll replace with real numbers after smoke run). Include a one-pager link with simple charts.

bex (growth-eng): I'll instrument events: mini_bench_signup, tokens_granted_mb, prompt_used_mb. Landing draft in #marketing-drafts in 2 hours.

zara-bot: Reminder — Mini-bench event created in calendar for Fri 10:00. :calendar: 

liam: Timeline: slides + one-pager by Wed EOD, landing + routing Thurs AM, run Fri. Quick pre-launch sync Thu 20min.

nina: Add a 48h micro-survey: two forced-choice questions + one free-text about blockers — helps catch quality/regression signals early.

harry: After the event, run a quick cohort-level quality check: % of prompts that return errors, free-text complaints in support, and any notable latency spikes.

liam: Sounds good. I'll post final landing URL here once live and share the bench csv after smoke tests. Reconvene Thu 11:00 for pre-launch.

everyone: +1
